mapper.select: SELECT order_id, signal_id, stock_code, trading_mode, order_type, quantity, order_price, executed_price, execution_status, blocked_by_risk_id, kiwoom_order_no, created_at FROM order_log WHERE trading_mode = #{tradingMode} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT order_id, signal_id, stock_code, trading_mode, order_type, quantity, order_price, executed_price, execution_status, blocked_by_risk_id, kiwoom_order_no, created_at FROM order_log WHERE trading_mode = #{tradingMode} AND execution_status = 'FILLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY stock_code, created_at ASC

SELECT order_id, signal_id, stock_code, trading_mode, order_type, quantity, order_price, executed_price, execution_status, blocked_by_risk_id, kiwoom_order_no, created_at FROM order_log WHERE trading_mode = #{tradingMode} AND execution_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') AND kiwoom_order_no IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE order_log SET execution_status = #{executionStatus}, executed_price = #{executedPrice}, updated_at = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
